maxDeferralDays.text: Days a security update may be held back

report.title: {Items.Count} update {Plural(Items.Count, 'ring defers', 'rings defer')} security updates for more than {params.maxDeferralDays} days

messages.businessImpact: Devices remain exposed to publicly known vulnerabilities for the whole deferral, and the details of those vulnerabilities are published the day the update is released.
remediation: Reduce the quality update deferral to no more than seven days for the broad ring and zero for the pilot.
